articles.title: Joseph Prentice, 86, Church Organist
articles.deck: Friends remember Joseph Prentice for the many years of service to Stonebridge.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Stonebridge. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee in his or her name.

Joseph Prentice died in November at home on Franklin Avenue, at the age of 86. Born in Stonebridge in the years after the war, Joseph Prentice spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Stonebridge. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee in his or her name.

articles.title: Council Splits 4–3 on Crosswalk

body: Councilmember Irene Cifuentes asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $850. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
